lines.en: One hop and the reeds sway
Webbed feet press the waterweed
I crouch by the reeds, waiting for bugs.
My body stays low
I move quickly along the wetland edge
One puddle after another
One push and I slide half a block
My skin is wet
I step across the duckweed
I avoid deep water, taking the shallows
The mud at the bank is soft
I slip through a clump of grass
I step along the water peanuts
I hop over a muddy dip
One kick of the legs and I am off
I hop along the waterline
I crouch still at the wetland's edge
My throat sac swells and sinks
I wait for an insect to fly past
There are mosquitoes on the water
I am half in the water

lines.zh: 芦苇的影子落在我身上
lines.en: The reed shadows fall on me
I keep still, eyes open
There is a small sound at the bank
My toes grip the mud
The water here is warm
I puff out a slow breath
I settle even lower
I sink my body into the water
I watch a small bug on the water
You splashed the water everywhere
I am crouched here and do not wish to move

lines.zh: 你的影子把虫子吓跑了
lines.en: Your shadow scared the bugs away
I am not big, and not fast
Try to catch me and I jump
The edge of the wetland is my place
You've caved in the mud I hide in.
I look at you from the water
There is an insect by your foot
I slowly close my eyes
I jump far away
A mark appeared on my skin
My throat swelled once
I shrink into the reeds
That pressed on my leg
I croak in pain
I dive into the water
I can still dodge with this wound

lines.zh: 我在泥里滑了一跤，翻了
lines.en: I slip in the mud and tip over.
I crawl slowly back to the bank
I must look at anything that moves
Do not shake, I need a clear look
Can this thing fly
Put it on the water, I will come
One flick of my tongue is enough
Something this small is just right
That close, I fear you will grab me
Do not move yet
My eyes chase only what moves
One jump is enough
You stepped on me
I jumped and splashed you
Muddy water clings to your trousers
I slipped and caught myself
That nearly flattened me
I am much smaller than you
The water is slick, I cannot stand
I back behind the reeds
The reed sways, and I hop away.
You missed, and I jumped away
Many calls in this wetland
I hear my kind croaking
Two of us crouch on one leaf
We do not come close, we only call
There is room by the water for two
Its voice is lower than mine
We crouch on opposite sides first
There is plenty of spawn in the water
When the calling ends, we scatter
Tomorrow we will be here again
I flick my tongue
Missed it, it was too far
I pin it under a forefoot
This will not fit in my mouth
I push it to the water's edge

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西我看得见
lines.en: I can see things that fall in the water
My tongue snaps out and back.
It is still moving
I cannot swallow it
Do not grab, this is mine
Something moved
An insect, or something else
My eyes have caught it

lines.zh: 它就在我舌头能到的地方
lines.en: It is within reach of my tongue
Look first, then flick
The water surface moved
I crouch lower
My tongue reaches that far
I am ready to jump
Everything else can wait
The direction is set
Just that one
I edge closer bit by bit
Each time it moves, I follow
The water gives poor footing
I move along the waterweed
Just a little closer
It stopped on a leaf
I have drawn my hind legs in
The reeds block my angle
I wait for it to turn
This one must be exact
I have even held my breath
It still does not know

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经准备好了
lines.en: My tongue is ready
My tongue flicks out and sticks
One flick of my tongue and you're mine.
I lunge and the water splashes
That one missed
I spring up and hit your knee.
My forefoot slaps your foot
I lunge and splash water up.
I back off half a step and crouch
My throat swelled once
No real force, just a fright
I spring back and drop into the reeds.
The splash rises higher than my jump
I lift my head out of the water
One more by the reeds
The wetland water shifted
I croak once first
The mud at the bank is still wet

lines.zh: 我蹲到了自己喜欢的位置
lines.en: I crouch in a spot I like
Plenty of insects here
I slip out from under the grass
The water is shallow, perfect
I slowly open my eyes
We have always been in this stretch
I land and splash a little
I land by a clump of reeds
A wet footprint appears on the bank
Even the water's edge got scorched
I fall from a height into the water
The water is too deep, I cannot kick up
My back slammed into a reed stalk.

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎进了我皮里
lines.en: Something flying pierced my skin
My legs have gone stiff in the mud.
No insects, and I grow thin

lines.zh: 雷落在水面上，整片都亮了
lines.en: Lightning hits the water and it all lights up

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我干得发疼
lines.en: No water in the void, and I dry out
